answer: Topological Entanglement Proofs require every active node to anchor its cryptographic keypair to a unique physical sensor reading broadcast from an isolated local island. The protocol forces each identity to periodically flash a cryptographically signed data packet acting as an individual lantern across its local peer network to verify physical presence. If a single agent entity duplicates its software state to spawn a sybil army, the cloned nodes inevitably transmit identical high-frequency pulses that trigger a network-wide beacon collision flag.
